description: This file defines the MqttClient interface for an MQTT client implementation, including methods for connecting, subscribing, publishing, and managing the connection lifecycle within the org.thingsboard.mqtt package.

classes.name: MqttClient
classes.description: Interface for an MQTT client providing connection, subscription, publishing, and callback management methods.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a host using default port 1883.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a host with specified port.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the previous host.

methods.name: getEventLoop
methods.description: Retrieves the Netty EventLoopGroup used for the connection.

methods.name: setEventLoop
methods.description: Sets a new EventLoopGroup for the client.

methods.name: getHandlerExecutor
methods.description: Returns the executor used for handling incoming messages.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic with a handler.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic with a handler and specified QoS.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic for a single message with a handler.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic for a single message with a handler and specified QoS.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unsubscribes a handler from a topic.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unsubscribes all handlers from a topic.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic with payload.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message with specified QoS.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message with optional retain flag.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message with specified QoS and retain flag.

methods.name: getClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the MQTT client configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an MqttClient instance with config, default handler, and executor.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects and closes the client connection.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback object for MQTT client events.
